description: JSON Schema for business_location class in Elephant Lexicon

basic_category.description: The source-provided cognitively basic category label. Overture values pass through unchanged and are not mapped to a closed Elephant vocabulary.

brand_name.description: The source-reported primary brand name. This source field does not itself establish a company or brand relationship.

brand_wikidata_identifier.description: The source-reported Wikidata identifier for the brand, when supplied. This source field is retained without normalizing the brand to a company.

hosted_service_rule.description: The versioned rule identifier that produced is_hosted_service, so consumers can audit or override the advisory classification.

is_hosted_service.description: An advisory derived flag indicating that the location may be a service hosted inside another business. It never excludes the location from ingestion.

name.description: The source-reported primary name of the physical business or point-of-interest location.

normalized_name.description: A normalized form of the location name used for deterministic matching. It does not itself establish a company relationship.

operating_status.description: The source-reported operating status for this release. Absence from a later release must not be interpreted as closure.

source_confidence.description: The source's confidence score for the location record. Consumers choose their own threshold because source confidence may not be calibrated across providers.

source_provenance.description: Source-record provenance entries retained for attribution, license checks, and re-identification across source releases.

confidence.description: The contributing dataset's confidence score, when supplied.

license.description: The source-reported license identifier for the contributing record, when supplied.

record_identifier.description: The contributing dataset's record identifier, when supplied.

updated_at.description: The contributing dataset's source update timestamp, when supplied.

source_record_identifier.description: The stable identifier assigned by the source system. For Overture places this is the GERS identifier.

source_record_version.description: The source-provided version of this location record, when available.

source_release.description: The source release or snapshot containing this observation. Category and status facts are interpreted relative to this release, and a changed release produces a new immutable observation.

source_system.description: The source system that assigned the record identifier, such as overture_places. Together with source_record_identifier, this identifies the source record family.

taxonomy_alternate.description: Other plausible source taxonomy labels. These are retained but are not substitutes for taxonomy_primary in category counts.

taxonomy_hierarchy.description: The ordered source taxonomy path from level zero through taxonomy_primary. Preserve this L0-to-primary order; do not reconstruct it from deprecated categories.primary.

taxonomy_primary.description: The source taxonomy's most specific primary category. Overture consumers count this field rather than alternate categories.
